paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: Paper sets limits on axioelectric coupling g_Ae for ALPs (absorption) in mass range ~0.03-0.2 keV/c2, plus dark photon kinetic mixing and DM-electron cross section. Coupling type AxionElectron applies to the g_Ae result. However, no numerical data points are given in the text or tables; limits are only shown in Fig. 2 which is not extractable from the provided content. DM density 0.3 GeV/cm3 stated explicitly.
